title: How to Reserve a Spot for an Event
content:
If a user asks how to reserve an event:

- Guide them to the CultPass app
- Instruct them to browse the experience catalog and tap 'Reserve'
- If it's a premium or limited event, check if reservation confirmation is required via email
- Remind them to arrive at least 15 minutes early with their QR code visible

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can reserve an experience by opening the CultPass app, selecting your desired event, and tapping 'Reserve'. Be sure to arrive 15 minutes early with your QR code ready."

title: What's Included in a CultPass Subscription
content:
Each user is entitled to 4 cultural experiences per month, which may include:
- Art exhibitions
- Museum entries
- Music concerts
- Film screenings and more

Some premium experiences may require an additional fee (visible in the app).

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Your CultPass subscription includes 4 curated experiences each month. You can choose from museums, concerts, film events and more. Premium events may have an extra cost, which is shown during reservation."

title: How to Cancel or Pause a Subscription
content:
Users can manage their subscription via the app > 'My Account' > 'Manage Plan'.

- Cancel: Effective at the end of the billing cycle
- Pause: Preserves user data, resumes automatically when reactivated
- Do NOT offer refunds unless approved by support lead

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can cancel or pause your subscription at any time via the 'My Account' section in the CultPass app. Cancelation takes effect at the end of your billing cycle."

title: How to Handle Login Issues?
content:
Most login issues are resolved with password reset:

- Ask the user to tap 'Forgot Password' on the login screen
- Ensure they are using the correct registered email
- If they did not receive the reset email, check spam folder or retry after 10 minutes
- For persistent login issues, escalate to human support

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Try tapping 'Forgot Password' on the login screen. Make sure you're using the email associated with your account. If the email doesn't arrive, check spam or try again in a few minutes."

title: How to Check Remaining Monthly Quota
content:
Members can see remaining experiences under My Account > This Month.

- Basic and Premium both start from a monthly quota (typically 4 for Basic)
- A reserved experience counts against quota even if the member later cancels within 24 hours of the event start
- Unused quota does not roll over to the next month

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Open CultPass, go to My Account, then This Month to see how many experiences you still have. Unused spots do not roll over."

title: QR Code Not Scanning at the Venue
content:
If a venue cannot scan the member QR code:

- Ask them to brighten the screen and disable dark mode / low-power brightness
- Confirm the reservation status is 'reserved' not cancelled
- Have staff enter the 6-character reservation id as a fallback
- If the member is blocked, staff must refuse entry and escalate

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Brighten your screen and open the reservation QR in the app. If it still fails, the venue can type your reservation id. If your account is blocked, we need to involve a human agent."

title: Premium Experiences and Extra Fees
content:
Premium-flagged experiences may show an extra fee during checkout.

- Extra fees are charged only after the member confirms
- Premium-tier subscribers sometimes receive a discount, shown in the app
- Extra fees are not refundable after the event start time

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Some CultPass experiences have an extra premium fee that appears before you confirm. After the event starts that fee is not refundable."

title: How to Change Email or Account Details
content:
Members update profile data in My Account > Profile.

- Email changes require confirmation from both the old and new address
- Name changes are allowed twice per year
- Payment method changes are under Billing

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can update your email and name in My Account > Profile. Email changes need confirmation from both addresses."

title: Refund Policy
content:
Refunds are exceptional.

- Subscription charges: no refund after the billing date unless required by law or approved by a support lead
- Premium extra fees: refundable only if CultPass cancelled the experience
- Duplicate charges: eligible for refund after confirming the payment ids
- Agents must use the refund tool only after escalation approval

**Suggested phrasing:**
"We generally cannot refund a billed month. If CultPass cancelled an experience or you were charged twice, a specialist can review a refund."

title: Blocked Account Policy
content:
An account may be blocked for unpaid invoices, suspected fraud, or venue incidents.

- Blocked members cannot reserve new experiences
- Existing reservations stay until a human agent reviews them
- Agents must escalate blocked-account tickets; do not unblock automatically

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Your account is currently blocked, so new reservations are paused. A specialist needs to review the block before we can reopen access."

title: How to Transfer or Cancel a Reservation
content:
Members can cancel from the reservation details screen.

- Cancel more than 24 hours before start: quota is restored
- Cancel inside 24 hours: quota is consumed
- Transfers to another member are not supported
- If the experience is sold out after cancel, we cannot guarantee a new spot

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can cancel from the reservation screen. More than 24 hours before start, the quota comes back. Transfers to another person are not available."

title: Weather and Event Cancellations
content:
If CultPass or the venue cancels:

- Quota is restored automatically
- Premium extra fees are refunded to the original payment method within 5 business days
- Members receive an in-app notice and email

**Suggested phrasing:**
"When we cancel an experience, your monthly quota is restored and any premium fee is refunded within five business days."

title: Guest Policy
content:
Each reservation is for one member.

- Guests are not included unless the experience title says otherwise
- Buying a second reservation for a guest requires a second CultPass account
- Children under 12 may accompany a member at selected museum experiences only

**Suggested phrasing:**
"A CultPass reservation covers one member. Guests need their own reservation unless the experience listing says companions are included."

title: Failed Payment or Expired Card
content:
If a renewal payment fails:

- We retry for 3 days
- After that the subscription status becomes cancelled and the account may be blocked for unpaid balance
- Members should update the card under My Account > Billing and tap Retry payment

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Update your card in My Account > Billing and tap Retry payment. If retries fail for three days the plan is cancelled."

title: How to Contact Human Support
content:
Escalate when:

- The member is blocked
- A refund is requested
- Login still fails after password reset
- Safety, harassment, or legal issues
- Confidence in the answer is low

Human support hours: 09:00-18:00 America/Sao_Paulo, Monday to Saturday.

**Suggested phrasing:**
"I am passing this to a human specialist with a summary of what we already checked."

title: Leaving a Review After an Experience
content:
Reviews open 2 hours after the scheduled start and stay open for 7 days.

- Reviews are visible to other members
- Report abusive reviews via the flag icon
- Reviews do not change quota

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can rate the experience in the app starting two hours after it begins. Reviews stay open for a week."
